sectorReasoning.reason: Explains common FX/input-cost and working-capital channels with inventory/pass-through/hedge contingencies, without assigning an invented sector.

counterevidence.reason: Explains why common exposures do not imply identical firm or equity-return behavior.

numericalInterpretation.reason: Correct exposure totals and percentages without inventing correlations/covariance.

decisionUsefulness.reason: Specifies hedging and sensitivity evidence before more common-factor exposure.

uncertainty.reason: Distinguishes missing correlation from zero and gross exposure from predicted loss.

missingEvidence: No current investment/market validation inferred; source inspection covers relevant selected pages rather than full issuer due diligence.
payload.independenceLimitation: Distinct actor IDs are provenance, not proof of independent humans or uncorrelated errors. Source answers and factual-error adjudication remain review responsibilities.
